name: cmdspace-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by CMDSPACE (커맨드스페이스): research pipeline, dev orchestrator, lecture-asset, and eagle-library

metadata.description: CMDS Process (Connect → Merge → Develop → Share) 기반 Claude Code 플러그인 모음

plugins.name: research-pipeline
plugins.description: Research-to-Publication Pipeline following the CMDS Process (Connect → Merge → Develop → Share). Orchestrates literature discovery, synthesis, manuscript drafting, editing, and journal formatting using 5 specialized sub-agents and 5 skills.

plugins.name: dev-orchestrator
plugins.description: Autonomous Development Orchestrator with 3-Tier agent system (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku). 13 specialized agents and 12 skills for the full SDLC — planning, architecture, implementation, testing, review, and documentation.

plugins.name: lecture-asset
plugins.description: Turn a finished lecture's transcript into reusable Obsidian knowledge assets: a hub note that summarizes and indexes the talk, the raw transcript preserved byte-for-byte, atomic claim cards cross-linked to your vault, a Bases view, and a read-only closing gate.

plugins.name: eagle-library
plugins.description: File images and other assets into Eagle (eagle.cool) libraries through the local API with consistent folders, names, tags and annotations; move items between libraries without breaking the Obsidian notes that link to them; check and repair those links; export Eagle folders into projects; and keep one Obsidian note per asset for a Bases image gallery.
